svg.title: Which OpenTelemetry JS setups read OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
svg.desc: Sandbox test on Node.js 22 with OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.1, starting 10,000 spans. BasicTracerProvider from sdk-trace-base 2.12.0 recorded 976 spans. NodeTracerProvider from sdk-trace-node 2.12.0 recorded 909. NodeSDK from sdk-node 0.300.0-rc.0 recorded 989. TracerProvider from sdk-trace 3.0.0-rc.0 recorded all 10,000, and so did TracerProvider from sdk-trace 2.12.0, because sdk-trace does not read the variables.
